A '''Jedi Seer''' was a specialized [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who pursued the teachings of the [[Jedi Consular]]s.

==Overview==
Serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as conduits to the [[Unifying Force/Legends|Unifying Force]], the Seers were responsible for receiving [[Force vision/Legends|Force visions]] and interpreting them for the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]]. Working closely with their brother and sister [[Lore Keeper]]s, the Seers updated and provided new information to store in the [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] of the Order. While nothing new by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], the ideals of the Seer were put in context within ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', a guidebook written by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] to help aid [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] to better understand the roles they would be able to pursue in the future. The section relating to the Jedi Seers was written by a member of their ranks, famed Seer [[Sabla-Mandibu]].<ref name="TJP" />

While [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could sometimes show aptitude in receiving visions from [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], there were only a select few which had a propensity for having the vivid Force dreams of a Seer. Capable of feeling the very will of the Force and seeing distant events, Seers were a vital part of the Order, often serving as a first alert to impeding surges in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. The Jedi Seers of the ancient past are responsible for the creations of many of the most well known stories of the Order. Those Seers capable of foretelling future events were dubbed '''Prophets''', and were the group that wrote down the [[Chosen One/Legends|Prophecy of the Chosen One]].<ref name="TJP" />

In the years immediately following the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the retired Master [[Krynda Draay]] began training a [[Jedi Covenant|secret group]] of Seers to prevent the rise of the dark side. Gathering [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] and other species gifted with [[Farsight/Legends|Farsight]], she formed WatchCircles to foresee and stop threats that may have endangered the Order. While her motives were based out of grief for the loss of her husband [[Barrison Draay|Barrison]], she would have laid down her life to protect her beloved Jedi Order. However, her husband's aide and caretaker [[Haazen]] devised a sinister plot to collect all of the [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] located by the WatchCircles and hoard them, biding his time until he could rule both Sith and Jedi. In the end, Haazen was destroyed and the Covenant disbanded, its members either killed, arrested, or in hiding following Haazen's failed attempt at [[Vindication]].<ref name="KOTORV">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Vindication]]''</ref>

Following the reconstruction of the [[New Jedi Order|Order]] in the wake of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], a [[Jedi Council of Seers]] was formed to foretell future events. The group saw the rise of [[Kol Skywalker]] and foretold that he would do great things for the Order.<ref name="Legacy 2006 24">[[Legacy (2006) 24|''Legacy'' (2006) 24]]</ref>
